BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled in the heart of the picturesque Offaly countryside, Mohia Lane, Killurin presents a rare opportunity to acquire a spacious and beautifully positioned 5-bedroom detached dormer bungalow on a generous site of approximately 1.13 acres. The large site offers excellent potential for the construction of an additional dwelling subject to the necessary planning permission. Offering the perfect balance of rural tranquility and modern convenience, this impressive family home enjoys  views of the nearby Slieve Bloom Mountains and the surrounding countryside, creating a truly stunning backdrop throughout the year and offering a wealth of outdoor activities including walking trails, cycling routes, hiking and nature exploration, making this an ideal location for outdoor enthusiasts. Mohia Lane enjoys an enviable countryside location while remaining exceptionally convenient to Tullamore Town, located less than 12 minutes away residents benefit from easy access to a full range of amenities including: Tullamore Train Station, Primary and Secondary schools, Shopping Centres, restaurants, Cafés and Leisure Amenities, Healthcare Services, Sporting and Recreational facilities.

Set on approximately 1.13 acres, the grounds offer exceptional privacy and space. The extensive site provides endless possibilities for gardening enthusiasts, hobby farmers, outdoor entertaining, or simply enjoying the peaceful countryside environment. Complementing the residence are a number of useful outbuildings including:
•	Storage Shed
•	Greenhouse
•	Additional ancillary storage facilities
These structures provide excellent versatility for storage, gardening projects, workshops, or a variety of recreational uses.
Whether enjoying morning coffee overlooking the rolling countryside, tending to the greenhouse and gardens, or exploring the extensive walking and cycling routes nearby, this property offers a lifestyle that is increasingly difficult to find.
Combining generous accommodation, accessibility, extensive grounds, practical outbuildings and an outstanding location, Mohia Lane represents a wonderful opportunity to secure a substantial family home in one of County Offaly's most scenic settings.
